headline: Protocol breach: Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner removed after viral video
summary: Yusuf Ali was made OSD after a video showed him attempting to embrace the prime minister at Rajshahi airport, sparking widespread online backlash.
details: Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner Yusuf Ali has been withdrawn and attached to the public administration ministry as an officer on special duty (OSD) following a protocol breach.

The action follows a visit by the head of government to Rajshahi on Tuesday, where a 14-second video clip showed Ali attempting to embrace the prime minister while seeing him off at Shah Makhdum Airport.

In the video, the prime minister is seen shaking hands with officials before Ali steps forward and extends an arm behind the leader's back, prompting the prime minister to step back and advise the official to remain in line.
The order for his withdrawal, issued Tuesday night, stated that the action was taken in the public interest and took effect immediately.
Ali handed over his responsibilities to Additional Divisional Commissioner (Revenue) Rezaul Alam Sarkar around 11pm on Tuesday.
The OSD position is generally viewed as a disciplinary measure, as officials in this role have no active part in policymaking or implementation processes.
This marks the second time in two months that the Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner's office has seen a change in leadership following administrative actions.
caption:

headline: 3 family members critically burned in Tongi gas blast
summary: A father, mother, and their 16-year-old daughter are fighting for their lives after a gas leak triggered an explosion in their home.
details: Three members of a single family were critically burned in a gas leak explosion in the Mudafa area of Tongi, Gazipur, on Wednesday morning.
The incident occurred around 6:00 AM in the Cherag Ali Market area when a gas leak triggered a fire while the mother was cooking.
The victims are identified as 60-year-old Md. Lalchan, his wife Nasima Begum (50), and their daughter Tanisa Akter (16).
According to residential surgeon Dr. Sultan Mahmud Shikdar, Lalchan suffered burns over 95% of his body, while Tanisa and Nasima suffered burns over 86% and 85% respectively.
All three victims are currently admitted to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery in Dhaka, with their conditions described as critical.
Tanisa Akter is being treated in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), while her parents are in the emergency department.
caption:
95%, 86%, and 85%—three family members are fighting for their lives after a devastating gas blast in Tongi.

Three members of a single family were critically burned in a gas leak explosion in the Mudafa area of Tongi, Gazipur, on Wednesday morning.

The incident occurred around 6:00 AM in the Cherag Ali Market area when a gas leak triggered a fire while the mother was cooking.

The victims are identified as 60-year-old Md. Lalchan, his wife Nasima Begum (50), and their daughter Tanisa Akter (16).

According to residential surgeon Dr. Sultan Mahmud Shikdar, Lalchan suffered burns over 95% of his body, while Tanisa and Nasima suffered burns over 86% and 85% respectively.

All three victims are currently admitted to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery in Dhaka, with their conditions described as critical.

Tanisa Akter is being treated in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), while her parents are in the emergency department.
